labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Broken link in CONTRIBUTING.md pointing AI_POLICY.md at the master branch instead of main.

body:
Thanks for spotting this. The link to AI_POLICY.md in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) points at the `master` branch, but this repository's default branch is `main`, so the link needs updating to `main`. This issue already describes that change. Pull requests are limited to collaborators, so please leave the fix here for a maintainer to review. Related PR-policy discussion is in #4203.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
